proposal.reason: Main functional change is adding a new built-in TROCE GIN backend end-to-end (plugin registration, GIN host lifecycle, GIN device API specializations, device/host shared ABI, and TROCE-specific queue/CQ progress and memory-registration paths). The Makefile, enum, and shared IB helper updates are supporting integration for this GIN backend rather than separate substantive changes in build or generic network modules.
